item.title: EAF + ASU: assess electrical demand and oxygen supply as one system
item.company_name: U. S. Steel Košice / Nippon Steel
item.project: Engineering lesson derived from the announced EAF + ASU investment programme
item.technology: EAF electrical load integration + ASU utility integration
item.project_status: Engineering guidance based on an announced, not yet commissioned, investment programme
item.project_status_evidence: Nippon Steel official release confirms the EAF and ASU investment decision and target dates; the engineering recommendation is IIG analysis.
item.company_context:
U. S. Steel Košice is a Slovak steelworks within Nippon Steel.

The project combines a major electric arc furnace investment with an air separation unit.

For FEED and grid studies, EAF demand, ASU demand, connection capacity and operating profiles should be assessed together.

advice.problem: EAF and ASU loads can be underestimated when electrical and utility interfaces are studied separately.
advice.checks: Verify coincident EAF and ASU load profiles, grid connection limits, power quality, redundancy philosophy and operating modes before design freeze.
advice.technical_solution: Develop one integrated electrical and utility design basis, model coincident demand and disturbances, and size connection and reserve architecture against verified operating cases.
advice.management_decision: Do not approve grid capacity, major electrical procurement or final interface limits until the integrated EAF–ASU study and design basis are signed.

item.title: AI data centers: lock grid, backup and heat-reuse assumptions before CAPEX
item.project: Engineering lesson derived from the announced Finnish AI infrastructure programme
item.technology: Grid connection + backup generation + waste-heat integration
item.project_status: Engineering guidance based on an announced investment programme; site-specific design remains prospective
item.project_status_evidence: Google's official release establishes the investment programme; the engineering checklist is IIG analysis, not a Google performance claim.
item.company_context:
Google operates cloud, AI and data-center infrastructure.

AI infrastructure creates material electrical connection, redundancy and cooling requirements.

Before fixing CAPEX, industrial data-center studies should reconcile grid capacity, backup philosophy, load profile and recoverable heat.

advice.problem: AI data-center CAPEX can be fixed before grid capacity, backup philosophy, cooling demand and recoverable heat are reconciled.
advice.checks: Verify utility connection capacity, phased IT load, redundancy level, backup runtime, cooling architecture, BESS role and heat-reuse boundary conditions.
advice.technical_solution: Build a staged energy balance and reliability model linking grid, backup generation, BESS, cooling and heat-reuse interfaces before equipment sizing.
advice.management_decision: Do not freeze electrical CAPEX or procure major backup and storage equipment until the load cases and resilience design basis are approved.
